methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing for leading AI music generators was collected from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible. Pages that rendered via JavaScript only (Mubert Render, Loudly, Soundraw, Udio) could not be fully parsed by automated fetch; for these, figures were taken from independent 2026 pricing-comparison sources (unite.ai, beebom.com, futurepedia.io, elegantthemes.com, slashdot.org) and cross-checked across at least two sources before inclusion. AIVA publishes prices exclusively in EUR; no USD self-serve price exists on their official page, so monthlyUsd is null for all AIVA plans with EUR figures recorded in notes. monthlyUsd records the month-to-month list price for flat tiers; where a vendor only publishes annual billing, monthlyUsd is the per-month equivalent at annual billing and the month-to-month rate (if known) is in notes. annualDiscountPct is set when both billing periods are publicly confirmed. These are non-telephony products: minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan. hipaa/baa/bilingual are null unless explicitly advertised. quote-only tiers carry monthlyUsd: null.
